newsitems.title: Screenshot Competition – Lightfooted!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d66fbf64694823ff8108572f51a5f97fb097c0db.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the 245th War Thunder Steam Screenshot Competition![/h1]

We loved seeing your submissions last week! This week we want to feature lightweight vehicles that have great speed and agility. Grab your favorite light vehicle, and capture a screenshot of it scouting on the battlefield, or participating in a dogfight! The three most popular and three selected by us will get 300 GE. See the winners down below!

[h2]Let’s begin the 245th edition of our competition![/h2]

Create a stunning screenshot and submit it on the War Thunder Steam Community Hub with the tag [b]#WTscreen245[/b]. You have time until the [b]16th of October[/b] to submit your screenshot.

After that date, 6 winners will be selected (3 of which will be the highest rated by the community and 3 selected by our judges), each of which receive a reward of 300GE.

[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3439537726 style=button]How to Participate![/url][/h1]

[h3]Terms:[/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Your screenshot must include an aircraft or helicopter with one engine, a light tank or wheeled vehicle, or a coastal fleet vehicle.
[*] You must add the #WTscreen245 tag (title cannot have any other text in it).
[*] Artists may only win by popular vote once per four screenshot competitions.[/b]
[*] Screenshots need to be compliant with the War Thunder rules.
[*] You need to be the author of the screenshot.
[*] Screenshot needs to be new. You cannot use those which have previously been published or used in other competitions.
[*] We will only accept raw screenshots from the game. You cannot use any editing software nor any other visual enhancements (like Nvidia Ansel filters).
[*] You can use filters and settings built into War Thunder.
[*] You can use the replay functionality built into War Thunder.
[*] Rewards will be delivered to the author's account within 14 working days.
[/list]

[h2]And now, time for the winners of the competition’s 244th edition – Standing Together![/h2]

[h3]Winners selected via community votes:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3813073255
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3812509644
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3812600382

[h3]Winners selected by our judges:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3813728351
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3813366590
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3812479035

Each winner will get 300GE! Congratulations and see you next week!

newsitems.title: Nuclear Escalation: Testing the Upgraded Southeastern City!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/816cb847efb712e1ada28322e10390f8bf3ec64d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Take part in testing the new map in Nuclear Escalation![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone! We’re working on expanding the selection of locations for Nuclear Escalation and the first candidate to join the list is the updated Southeastern City map![/p][p][/p][quote][p]Testing is available from October 7th (11:00 GMT) until October 9th (11:00 GMT) in the Events and Tournaments tab.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2][b]Updates to Southeastern City[/b][/h2][p]We’ve carried out some significant revisions to Southeastern City. One of the most important changes is the switch to height-map technology, similar to how it works in a recent update to the Afghanistan map. This technology allows for a more detailed landscape. We’ve also improved some terrain elements: the map now features detailed sandy and rocky shores, the mountains have more textured surfaces, and forests and villages have been added to the northern section, which previously only consisted of open fields. Vegetation has also been improved, we’ve replaced existing models with new ones and the ground cover is now more dense, with trees appearing on mountain slopes as well. The finishing touches include reworking the water color and adjusting weather settings to make the map look more vibrant than ever before.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/984a017e923509e5a03d69ba7ac3e7b80afb9040.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/85be299f5f3f45787164c0a1f5498ca97b656e6c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2d7922817b1420974f2e3a212bc498c96fe68bd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d80e211a0fdbdb7d9ee5a3abf6ef9a23230d4deb.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/aadac28be8b4c106ebfa157560c033164a8b38c2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3eb6151c06fe922d79c2fcb1d3a963ba270ec011.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]More details about testing[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]The test will cover the same Battle Rating range as the main mode, from 8.7 to 14.7, using the same matchmaking rules and Battle Rating brackets that determine the ground AI lineups in battle.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We want to see how the mode plays out on this map in practice and decide on the next steps based on the results. For instance, we anticipate that the map’s smaller size might lead to excessive action density at top tiers, potentially requiring us to cap the maximum mission Battle Rating.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Play Nuclear Escalation on the Southeastern City map and be sure to share your feedback with us. Good luck and have fun![/p]

newsitems.title: It’s fixed! №118
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents:
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/67a0a88280cd66a544ab5b7be0773930e4e11b93.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]Today, we’ve rounded up and will be covering some of the fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check out the [url="https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/"][u]changelog section on our website[/u][/url].[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on [url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder"][u]our community bug reporting platform[/u][/url].[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Refinement of the bomber damage model[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/cdc9fb2f501d920894ba346c57b0fbe6b49c9b40.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]The update to the bomber damage model significantly changed gameplay across many Battle Ratings and received a positive reception. However, the updated aircraft were sustaining too little damage. Today, we have implemented comprehensive adjustments to the damage model to ensure that bombers are not excessively survivable.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]First of all, we revised the aircraft skin settings so that HE shell fragments and small-caliber machine-gun fire should better penetrate bomber skins and damage internal modules. Previously, even large high-explosive shells often failed to deal sufficient damage when hitting vulnerable areas.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Another issue occurred as well: even high-speed collisions between bombers and fighters often failed to cause damage. We’ve made a number of adjustments: damage from aircraft collisions is being increased. Ramming will once again become an effective last resort![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]These changes were made based on your feedback, and we hope you enjoy them. Be sure to try them out and share your thoughts![/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Updates to the Southeastern City location[/b][/h2][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/984a017e923509e5a03d69ba7ac3e7b80afb9040.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/85be299f5f3f45787164c0a1f5498ca97b656e6c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2d7922817b1420974f2e3a212bc498c96fe68bd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d80e211a0fdbdb7d9ee5a3abf6ef9a23230d4deb.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/aadac28be8b4c106ebfa157560c033164a8b38c2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3eb6151c06fe922d79c2fcb1d3a963ba270ec011.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p align="justify"]Southeastern City has undergone significant revisions. The most important change was the switch to height-map technology, similar to the recent update for the Afghanistan map, which allows for a more detailed landscape. Specific terrain elements were also improved: the map now features detailed sandy and rocky shores, the mountains have more textured surfaces, and forests and villages have been added to the northern section, which previously consisted only of open fields. Vegetation has also been improved; existing models were replaced with new ones and the ground cover is now denser, with trees appearing on mountain slopes as well. The finishing touches included reworking the water color and adjusting weather settings to make the map look more vibrant than ever before.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679637128142915834"]We've also launched testing for Nuclear Escalation on this map![/url][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Nuclear Escalation Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fb463196c7a7c863376edb57b3cc701d32815d92.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Speaking of Nuclear Escalation! Alongside expanding the list of locations, we’ve fixed a number of issues affecting the logic of mission, buildings, and ground vehicles.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Previously, damage to ground vehicles would often effectively disable them without destroying them completely; vehicles would fail to resume movement after running gear repairs or crew replacement. Now, however, after a vehicle is damaged, the crew will recover, get the vehicle back in working order, and continue on to their destination.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]However, there were two other bugs that prevented the convoys from successfully reaching their destination. Not only could convoys block each other and get stuck, but a convoy might not even have left the armored vehicle depot at all, since another convoy at the garrison (the destination) was considered active, which prevented the dispatch of a new one. These bugs have now been fixed.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Missile Fixes[/b][/h2][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b1d6f0e27c6961e91de2cf149723cd4200304f49.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]Due to errors, air-to-air missiles could either deal very little damage or no damage at all. For example, because of an error in the fuse’s logic, air-to-air missiles and surface-to-air missiles failed to damage rapidly approaching enemy missiles, detonating slightly before the point of closest approach. And due to an error in the logic governing the missile’s explosion itself, in some cases they failed to inflict damage on other aircraft from direct hits and explosions.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]That’s not all[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Check out the full list of fixes and improvements in the update notes below! Here’s some more: weapon icons on the tactical map now appear on a layer below player markers and no longer overlap them; wheeled vehicles no longer shake when they lose all the wheels on one side; aircraft carriers now move from the edge of the map to its center on all Air Battles maps where they appear, and the view in VR no longer jitters when the game is launched using the DirectX 11 graphics API.[/p][p][/p][h3]Previous Updates:[/h3][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679637128142915648"]Update 2.59.0.49[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679637128142915437"]Update 2.59.0.46[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679637128142913624"]Update 2.59.0.43[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679636495422719235"]Update 2.59.0.38[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Today's Update 2.59.0.54[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Aircraft[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="justify"][b]Bomber Damage Model:[/b] Collision damage between aircraft has been increased. Previously collisions resulted in insufficient damage of wings and tail and didn’t lead to their separation. HE shell fragments and small-caliber machine-gun fire now penetrate the skin of the aircraft better and deal damage to the internal modules.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]F-4E AUP Phantom II[/b] — the targeting pod camera settings and AGM-65D/G missiles seekers camera settings have been corrected. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bBM10OnBO5m2"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Locations and Missions[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="justify"][b]Southeastern City[/b]  — the location has been reworked. It has been switched to height-map technology, allowing for greater overall landscape detail. Specific landscape elements have also been updated, detailed sandy and rocky shores have been added, mountains have more textured surfaces, there are now forests and villages on the northern part of the location, which used to only have fields. Vegetation assets have been replaced with new ones, ground cover is more dense, with trees appearing on mountain slopes. Water color has been reworked, some weather settings have been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="justify"]An issue where stones would fly out of the ground upon running over a crashed UAV has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue where shadows on aircraft could appear jittery has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="justify"]In the weapon comparison window, short names are now displayed in the selection list and in the list of compared munitions so that the weapons can be quickly distinguished from one another.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue where locked avatars and avatar frames in the player profile window could only be clicked on their upper sections has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue in the vehicle preset editing window where moving the cursor away from the name input field caused text input to stop has been fixed. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/RGaidYi01z0X"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue where a text key was displayed in the kill log and battle log when a vehicle was destroyed for leaving the battle area has been fixed. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/EmbMLsqh9uKI"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]Pantsir SM-SV[/b] — an issue where the 270-degree line was missing from the radar display in third-person view has been fixed. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/HSuJ0SvlDK14"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue where the shell armor penetration graph displayed incorrectly when opened from the vehicle stat card has been fixed. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/2E0EuA4OYyAl"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]An issue where certain shells were missing from the shell list in the protection analysis, for example the BR-281SP shell for the WZ305 has been fixed. ([url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/SmcYUOSODc1S"][u][b]Report[/b][/u][/url]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]H145M[/b] — an issue where the tooltip for the LWR system was missing from the vehicle stat card has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]Pantsir-S1[/b] — an issue where radar information was duplicated in the vehicle stat card has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]AH-64D[/b] — an issue where selecting a weapon loadout without the AMASE MAWS blocks installed would still indicate the presence of the MAWS in the X-ray view has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Screenshot Competition – Standing Together!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d66fbf64694823ff8108572f51a5f97fb097c0db.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the 244th War Thunder Steam Screenshot Competition![/h1]

Thanks for all of your fantastic submissions last week! This week, grab a friend for a group photograph! It has been said many times before, but working in pairs carries a great number of advantages. One of the biggest advantages? It gives the enemy someone else to focus their fire at! The three most popular and three selected by us will get 300 GE. See the winners down below!

[h2]Let’s begin the 244th edition of our competition![/h2]

Create a stunning screenshot and submit it on the War Thunder Steam Community Hub with the tag [b]#WTscreen244[/b]. You have time until the [b]9th of October[/b] to submit your screenshot.

On October 3rd 1990, the GDR and FRG became one country! German Unity Day is a major national holiday, widely celebrated throughout the country. We join in the congratulations and invite you to celebrate the anniversary with a decal and discounts![/p][p][/p][h2]Unique bundles in the store![/h2][p][/p][p]From October 2nd (11:00 GMT) until October 5th (11:00 GMT) unique bundles with German vehicles will be available in the Gaijin.Net store with a 50% discount.[/p][p][/p][p][b]To get to the Gaijin Store through Steam, go to the in-game hangar > Shop > Online Store.[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][b]“Many Strengths – One Country” Bundle[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f6544457a874b68c718f628f92857088b667fac9.png"][/img][/p][p][strike][b]74.97[/b][/strike][b] 37.49[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This bundle includes:[/p][list][*][p]Z-20 Karl Galster Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Scout Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Bf 109Z Zwilling Pack[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][h3][/h3][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][b]“German Unity Day 2026” Bundle[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/502f82d7c37896fe3d9d306775c406e8777e18a3.png"][/img][/p][p][strike][b]120[/b][/strike][b] 59.99[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This bundle includes:[/p][list][*][p]Alpha Jet A Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard Pack[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Pz.Sfl.Ic, Bf 109 Z-1 and Z20 Karl Galster are temporarily available for Golden Eagles at a discount![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]All three vehicles are 30% off:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Pz.Sfl.Ic (rank II) for 700 Golden Eagles[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Bf 109 Z-1 (rank IV) for 2086 Golden Eagles[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Z20 Karl Galster (rank III) for 3416 Golden Eagles[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]About these vehicles[/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]The [url="https://wiki.warthunder.com/Pz.Sfl.Ic"][u]Pz.Sfl.Ic[/u][/url] is an experimental light tank built during the Second World War based on the chassis of the VK 9.01. It’s fitted with a two-man turret housing a 50mm Pak 38 cannon, requiring a complete stop to fire accurately. However, the tank is extremely mobile and capable of penetrating almost any enemy at its rank with ease![/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1464371c679b269068ee67e47045b5bbb3cbf0f1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0ade08ea2e07446cca7153641ffc9b3b542350a6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/656b601998be1dc99a1373874af545c23cca1863.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6506dd31c8308de800cbe9dc13c2fe8425ac32cd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8e725764a5e24fcae6c1192cebfa5a64db8ae0ec.jpg"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p align="justify"]The [url="https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/bf-109z"][u]Bf 109 Z-1[/u][/url] is an experimental twin-fuselage fighter armed with four 30 mm MK 108 cannons. Scoring hits with these guns is no easy task, making the Bf 109 Z-1 best suited for hunting bombers and other large, sluggish targets especially at high altitudes, where the fighter can reach high speeds.[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f2ba6c7632f81e4c4a79a2749f29889e9ff925ce.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/216176450d873b569602b0c89c5681e4af2ff3cd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9cc41a2e22b94777cfe9299f4ccfa17a50507f76.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/17f6c511ac48968134cf8b06dc14dcbd889d645d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9e6fc7e23981654e51cabce8b995d623ab5d6edd.jpg"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p align="justify"]The [url="https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/germ_destroyer_class1936_z20_karlgalster"][u]Z20 Karl Galster[/u][/url] is a Second World War veteran featured in the game in a late-war configuration boasting an excellent anti-aircraft suite comprising thirteen 20 mm autocannons. newsitems.title: Desert Predator: AMV (BMP-3)
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7960fa1a854b9c618d5f999764ffa24fd74da5cb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Meet the vehicle reward in the Desert Predator event, the Finnish Patria wheeled combat vehicle equipped with the BMP-3 combat module![/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][b]AMV (BMP-3):[/b] An Event Vehicle Light Tank for Sweden at Rank VI[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]At a glance:[/p][list][*][p]100 km/h top speed[/p][/*][*][p]30 mm autocannon and 100 mm gun-launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Thermal sight for the gunner[/p][/*][*][p]Relatively high profile[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6334191051c4f72ee2a1ca6848dbe7b2481edc31.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Introducing the AMV (BMP-3)![/b][/h3][p align="justify"]This vehicle combines the Finnish Patria AMV wheeled chassis with the turret of the Russian BMP-3! The BMP-3’s turret, featuring a 30 mm automatic cannon and a 100 mm gun-launcher capable of firing tandem-warhead ATGMs, is now mounted on a fast wheeled chassis. Let’s take a closer look![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Using the AMV (BMP-3) in Battle[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The AMV (BMP-3) combines the best features of both platforms. The Patria chassis utilizes an 8x8 wheel configuration and is capable of speeds of 100 km/h. Its BMP-3 combat module, equipped with thermal imaging, is well-suited for both close-range and long-range engagements. In urban combat, the 30 mm autocannon is highly effective, while the 100 mm gun’s HE rounds prove useful against light targets. The vehicle’s performance differs significantly at long ranges, where anti-tank missiles become the primary weapon. Although its armor is not designed to withstand tank shells, it reliably resists machine-gun fire and can even survive hits from certain early-generation ATGMs thanks to its composite armor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/69de7f0b0f0698ab4d5935ca1c80143df957b8a3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Feature Spotlight: Two Cannons[/b][/h3][p]The BMP-3 turret features different types of weaponry, it has a 100 mm gun-launcher, a 30 mm automatic cannon, and a machine gun. While the 100 mm gun’s ammunition includes HE shells, its most effective rounds are Anti-Tank Guided Missiles, of which you can carry up to eight. The 30 mm gun has HE belts that are useful against helicopters, while APDS rounds are great in close-range engagements against armored vehicles, allowing you to disable guns, tracks and strike enemy tanks in the flank![/p][p][/p][p][b]Developer comment:[/b] The Patria AMV is a promising modern modular platform. Players are already familiar with it via the Finnish CT-CV 105HP, though the AMV (BMP-3) variant utilizes an upgraded, extended chassis with increased spacing between the second and third wheel pairs. This new Patria offers a fresh take on the mobile chassis, and most importantly it’s Sweden’s first wheeled tank at rank VI. It serves as a strong alternative to the tracked CV series, particularly on urban maps with paved roads where the AMV (BMP-3) truly shines![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/cf0fd8f2035cb139b75f0b3aa729f67912981da4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Vehicle History[/b][/h3][p]In 2007, a wheeled Patria vehicle featuring the BMP-3 turret was unveiled at the IDEX exhibition. In January 2008, the UAE ordered 15 extended-hull Patria AMV chassis. The plan was to equip them with turrets from the BMP-3 (which was already in service with the UAE) featuring Namut thermal imaging sights. In 2016, the UAE General Staff ordered another 40 Patria AMV chassis, with an option for an additional 50 units. The exact number of vehicles currently in service remains unknown.[b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p]You can get the AMV (BMP-3) through the Desert Predator vehicle event, which started today! Be sure to follow the link below to learn how you can obtain this interesting vehicle.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/679636495422719730"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="center"][i]Please note that vehicle specifications may be subject to revision and change before being added to the game.[/i][/p]

The most solemn ceremonies take place in Beijing’s Tiananmen Square, where the founding of the PRC was proclaimed in 1949. newsitems.title: Fair Play: September 2026
newsitems.author: magazine2
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/dbfee5603f9da529f0681f3dee3558ea220f997d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your reports and our anti-cheat systems continue to help us in the fight against cheaters. As is tradition, we’re sharing information about the bans issued since last [url="https://warthunder.com/en/news/10129-fair-play-fair-play-july-2026-en"][u]Fair Play[/u][/url]. If you want to help rid War Thunder of cheaters and unsportsmanlike players, you can learn how to submit a report and how our anti-cheat system works [url="https://wiki.warthunder.com/mechanics/anticheat"][u]on our wiki[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Banned accounts[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Since our last fair play update, we have banned 3,984 accounts that were found to have violated the rules, specifically paragraph 3.2.3 of the EULA, namely the automation of gameplay (use of bots) and cheat software.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Additionally, 661 temporary bans were issued for violating paragraph 3.2.3 of the EULA, specifically for intentionally exploiting a bug that allowed for gaining excessive mission score in Air Simulator Battles during the Space Program Event.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Furthermore, 397 accounts were banned for a week or longer for intentional teamkilling and griefing, including 13 permanent bans.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]For complete transparency, we will publish [u][url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSb9OfOUuFsZCv4_nOXdE-okkWblZ0B06X7rIX1bUJr11KsZCiHd1BaHDrBiTvFMRVWH_HAYTUkOdZm/pubhtml?gid=186266447&single=true"]the full list of permanently banned players[/url][/u]. This list will be available for two weeks following the publication of this article.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Recommendations[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]We recommend that you set a strong password for your account and enable two-step authentication in [url="https://login.gaijin.net/en/profile/settings/security/"]your profile security settings[/url]. We have the following 2FA options available: email, SMS, TOTP ([url="https://support.gaijin.net/hc/en-us/articles/360001795258-Gaijin-Pass"][u]Gaijin Pass[/u][/url]/Google Authenticator).[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We’d also suggest that you turn on 2FA for the email that is linked to your Gaijin account for additional security, as this will protect your account from fraudsters. And remember, don’t use prohibited client modifications and never share your account information with anyone.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]The War Thunder Team[/p]

([b][u][url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/aoXGN2LMgWHf"]Report[/url][/u][/b]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]F4U-7 (France)[/b] — New 20 mm cannons modification has been moved from tier III of modification research to tier II. A bug that caused the tier bonus column to not fit in the modification window has been fixed. ([b][u][url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Wy3al7AskfWU"]Report[/url][/u][/b]).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]Aircraft torpedoes F5W, W 170/450[/b] — a bug that caused the drop limits of these torpedoes to change has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Ground Vehicles[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]M24 (Italy)[/b] — a bug that caused all identification marks to disappear has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]M24 (all variants), IS-2 (all variants), T-44 (all variants), Panzer IV/70(V), T58[/b] — moments of inertia have been corrected. In some cases the handling is now more responsive and precise.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]T58[/b] — a bug that caused the stowage in the hull and not in the turret to count as the first-stage ammo has been fixed. ([b][u][url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/7v4YEQzAwQXa"]Report[/url][/u][/b]). A bug that caused some ammo stowage modules to evoke damage effects from other ammo stowage modules (for example, fire instead of explosion and vice-versa) when hit or destroyed, or to not evoke any effects at all (just becoming black) has been fixed.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A bug that caused the tactical map movement cursor mode to not deactivate when releasing RB/R1 button when playing with a controller has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]A bug that caused the performance to noticeably drop when moving the cursor in the artillery support call window has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Nuclear Escalation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]In battles with a session Battle Rating of 11.3-13.0, BMP-2s in tank columns have been replaced with ZSU-23-4M4, and T-80B tanks in columns and strongpoints have been replaced with T-80U.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url="https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder"]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Get the AMV (BMP-3) in the Desert Predator Event!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/92dd0894ffe6b558efee46bd031beb9f40e39ba5.png"][/img][/p][p]A hybrid combat vehicle featuring the Patria AMV chassis and a BMP-3 turret was unveiled for the first time at the IDEX 2007 exhibition in Abu Dhabi. To produce these models, the hull of the Finnish vehicle was specially lengthened to accommodate the new combat compartment. These vehicles remain in service with the United Arab Emirates Armed Forces to this day. Take part in the new event to earn the AMV (BMP-3) and UAE-themed decals![/p][p][/p][quote][p]From October 1st (11:00 GMT) until October 19th (11:00 GMT), earn mission points in Ground Battles, unlock stages and receive rewards![/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]AMV (BMP-3): An Event Vehicle Light Tank for Sweden at Rank VI[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6334191051c4f72ee2a1ca6848dbe7b2481edc31.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]The AMV (BMP-3) features the Finnish Patria AMV chassis and the turret from the Russian BMP-3, enabling it to reach speeds of 100 km/h. The turret is equipped with two guns, the 30 mm automatic cannon for close-range combat, and a 100 mm gun-launcher capable of firing HE rounds and two types of ATGMs.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/542d75504ed617f51690a51306d4462f62719dcc.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/07df53fba98e8c3a53067e51d0e0353bdddcd456.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/529d1d75d5d426736ccd9141dda64331f8aefa0e.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]“[b]UAE Presidential Guard Emblem[/b]” decal [/p][/td][td][p align="center"]“[b]UAE Armed Forces Emblem[/b]” decal[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]“[b]Patria AMV BMP-3[/b]” loading screen[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/28498db570b8a9f14b07d36d179b7e586242dc29.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="center"]Bicolor desert camouflage[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Among the rewards in the event is also this chest. When opened, there is a chance to receive one of the following items:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]50,000 - 100,000 Silver Lions[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Silver Lion and Research Point boosters[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Random Wagers and Orders[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Universal Backups (1 - 3)[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]A random camouflage for a vehicle you own[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]1 day of Premium Account[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]How to get all rewards[/h2][p align="justify"]Each stage can be completed for [b]35,000[/b] mission points, where every new stage obtained will give you a new reward.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][b]Please note:[/b] After finishing a stage, you need to collect the reward manually. To do this, click on your name in-game, go to “Desert Predator” and click the “Get Reward” button.[/p][/quote][p] [/p][p align="justify"]You’re able to earn mission points in [b]Ground Battles[/b] at Rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic and Simulator Battles. The number of mission points to complete a stage depends on the game mode and the maximum Rank of the vehicle that you use in battle. There’s a multiplier for earning mission points, which is shown in the task description in-game. Points are only awarded at the end of the battle.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]You can also earn mission points by using event vehicles that are Rank I and II. Event vehicles that can be used have the name of the event that they were obtainable in on their stat card.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT on October 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th and 17th.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages[/h2][list][*][p align="justify"]For [b]1[/b] Stage: trophy with a random reward[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]2[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]3[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]4[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]5[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]6[/b] Stages: “Patria AMV BMP-3” loading screen[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]7[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]8[/b] Stages: non-tradable coupon for the Patria AMV BMP-3[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]For [b]9[/b] Stages: unique camouflage and four random modifications for the Patria AMV BMP-3[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Discounts on purchasing stages using Golden Eagles[/h2][p align="justify"]Unfinished stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but if you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will be significantly reduced as well.[/p][p align="justify"]Let’s say you have earned 85% of the required mission points to complete a stage, then the price of purchasing this stage will be halved. If you’re near the finish line for a stage and are at 95% progress, then the price will be reduced by five times. For example, if you’ve scored 30,000 mission points, then the price for unlocking this stage will be 349 Golden Eagles. If you’ve scored 33,500 mission points, then you’ll only need 139 Golden Eagles. Keep this in mind if you’re not able to complete a stage in time![/p][p][/p][h2]The Upgrade for coupon[/h2][p align="justify"]When you complete 8 stages, you’ll receive a non-tradable coupon for the Patria AMV BMP-3, where using it will immediately activate the vehicle onto your account. If you don’t want the vehicle and would like to sell the coupon on the Market, you’ll need the “Upgrade for coupon” item.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]The “Upgrade for coupon” item can be earned in parallel with the stages throughout the event from October 1st (11:00 GMT) until October 19th (11:00 GMT) for 600,000 mission points.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p align="justify"]After receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” item, you can convert a non-tradable coupon for the vehicle into a tradable one and sell it on the Market. The tradable coupon can be sold after 6 days from the moment it’s created.[/p][p][/p][quote][p align="justify"]To make a tradable coupon, select the “Coupon Patria AMV BMP-3” (Sweden)” in your inventory and click the “Modify” button.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p align="justify"]The “Upgrade for coupon” item is valid until October 23rd (11:00 GMT). Until this time, you can use it or exchange it for War Bonds. Afterwards, it’ll disappear from your inventory.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]You can track the progress of the stages and the “Upgrade for coupon” item by clicking on your Nickname > Achievements > Desert Predator. If you don’t manage to complete a stage in time or would like to purchase a stage, you can purchase each stage with Golden Eagles until [b]October 23rd [/b]from the Achievements window, which will give you the corresponding rewards.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p]

newsitems.title: Screenshot Competition – Into the Fray!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d66fbf64694823ff8108572f51a5f97fb097c0db.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the 243rd War Thunder Steam Screenshot Competition![/h1]

We enjoyed getting to see your screenshots from the latest major update, Sky Odyssey! For this competition, we’re looking to capture screenshots of vehicles in combat. Pick your favorite vehicle, and capture it in the heat of battle - whether it is with a display of firepower, or the middle of a dogfight! The three most popular and three selected by us will get 300 GE. See the winners down below!

[h2]Let’s begin the 243rd edition of our competition![/h2]

Create a stunning screenshot and submit it on the War Thunder Steam Community Hub with the tag [b]#WTscreen243[/b]. You have time until the [b]2nd of October[/b] to submit your screenshot.

After that date, 6 winners will be selected (3 of which will be the highest rated by the community and 3 selected by our judges), each of which receive a reward of 300GE.

[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3439537726 style=button]How to Participate![/url][/h1]

[h3]Terms:[/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Your screenshot must capture combat action.
[*] You must add the #WTscreen243 tag (title cannot have any other text in it).
[*] Artists may only win by popular vote once per four screenshot competitions.[/b]
[*] Screenshots need to be compliant with the War Thunder rules.
[*] You need to be the author of the screenshot.
[*] Screenshot needs to be new. You cannot use those which have previously been published or used in other competitions.
[*] We will only accept raw screenshots from the game. You cannot use any editing software nor any other visual enhancements (like Nvidia Ansel filters).
[*] You can use filters and settings built into War Thunder.
[*] You can use the replay functionality built into War Thunder.
[*] Rewards will be delivered to the author's account within 14 working days.
[/list]

[h2]And now, time for the winners of the competition’s 242nd edition – Sky Odyssey![/h2]

[h3]Winners selected via community votes:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3805581671
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3805688227
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3806180654

[h3]Winners selected by our judges:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3807004386
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3807069477
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3804270294

Each winner will get 300GE! Congratulations and see you next week!
